abstract: In this issue, Wang et al. (https://doi.org/10.1083/jcb.202511010) show that adult Drosophila horizontal system dendrites remain structurally and functionally intact despite mitochondrial depletion, contrasting with the necessity of mitochondria during development. Their findings suggest that visual system functionality does not require mitochondrial functions under ideal conditions.
